text:
alex: Quick kickoff for the eu-south-2 integration sprint. Goal: beta staging traffic in ~3 weeks. Owning up dependencies and blockers here so we can move async. TL;DR: need KMS + residency signoff, routing/egress policy, quota for dedicated capacity, DNS + certs, and observability dashboards.

alex: Proposed milestones:
- week1: infra provision & KMS keys (baseline)
- week2: routing + DNS + certs, CRs merged
- week3: staging traffic shift, canary metrics
Can owners confirm? Also ping for code review windows.

priya: I can take KMS + data residency. I'll pick up the KMS key PR (#4123) and the residency checklist. Need legal to confirm key provenance by Tue. @legal-ops can you chime in? :wave:

sam: I'll own routing/egress. Need the cloud provider IP blocks and BGP peering contact. Also want to validate fallback policies for overloaded azs. I'll open PRs for `routing-allowlist` and `edge-fallback` later today.

jen: Observability here. I'll create the SLI dashboard and add tracing hooks. Can someone drop a sample trace or synthetic traffic pattern? Need that for baseline.

mike: Infra/capacity owner. Requesting quota bump for GPU pool and ephemeral nodes. Finance: we need a provisional budget approval for reserved capacity (3 weeks runway). Also will prepare an ops toggle so we can scale down after beta.

alex: Quick ask for the group: please review these PRs in `region/eu-south-2` branch when ready. If you can review within 24h of PR creation it helps sequencing.

sam: Ack — I'll review routing PRs EOD. PR names: `routing-allowlist` (#4210) and `edge-fallback` (#4211).

priya: Legal replied in DM, need a short statement from product about storage retention for backups. Also: residency question — do backups need to stay in-region or can we replicate to eu-central for DR? @mike ?

mike: Short answer: primary backups should stay in-region for GDPR, DR can be in eu-central if we have contractual justification. I'll add a policy snippet to infra repo. Example toggle in `infra/regions.yaml`:
```yaml
regions:
  eu-south-2:
    capacity_profile: small-beta
    backup_replication: false
```
Change `backup_replication: true` requires legal approval.

doris: Security review: need updated data flow diagram with the new peering and KMS key flow. Drop it in `docs/diagrams/eu-south-2.png`. Also I'll run a quick threat model once diagram is in.

alex: For staging smoke runs, use this quick curl to hit the canary endpoint (staging cluster):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://staging-eu-south-2.api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Share results in thread.

deploy-bot: staging cluster `eu-south-2-staging` created — kube contexts: `stg-eu-s2`. Autoscaling group up (3 nodes).

jen: Canary criteria suggestion: error rate <0.5% over 10m, p99 latency <200ms, token cost within 10% of baseline. If any fail, automatic rollback to hosted model.

doris: Also need DPA and data processing addendum signed before prod. Tagging @legal-ops again.

priya: I'll queue the residency docs and the KMS rotation runbook. Will post PR link in thread when ready.

mike: I'll request quota increases today and post the ticket number. If finance can approve provisional spend, we can reserve capacity tomorrow.

alex: Action items summary:
- priya: KMS + residency docs + PR (#4123)
- sam: routing PRs (#4210, #4211) + peering contacts
- mike: quota request + infra toggle + budget ask
- jen: SLI dashboard + canary runbook
- doris: security diag + threat model
- legal: DPA + key provenance confirmation
Everyone: please ack when you have time to review PRs and I'll schedule a lightweight sync if we need it. Next async check-in 48h. :calendar: 

sam: acked, will review PRs and drop peering contact.

jen: acked, will start dashboard and post URL.

priya: acked, will post PR link here.

mike: acked, filing quota ticket now.

doris: acked, will upload diagram by EOD.

alex: thanks all — leaving this thread open for async updates. :rocket:
